description.value: Sells cold email and sales engagement software; its tools cover lead finding, outreach automation, email deliverability, and a CRM, with AI features throughout.
Lets users find leads, create AI Sales Agents, and automate outreach and sales.
Sales platform that combines cold email automation with a built-in B2B Lead Database.
A comprehensive suite for sales automation and lead management.

product_description.value: Outreach and automation (campaign creation, AI Sales Agent, AI Reply Agent, AI BDR, Automations, AI Agents); lead generation (B2B Lead Database, Lead Finder Agent, Website Visitors, Email Verification); deliverability (Inbox Placement, email warmup, Email Accounts); a CRM with revenue tracking; AI copilot, AirMail, and Managed Services.

AI Sales Agent, Outreach, Lead Database, Verification, CRM, Website Visitors, Inbox Placement, Deliverability, Email Accounts, Automations, Lead Finder Agent, AI Agents, AI BDR, AI Reply Agent, AirMail, and Managed Services.
Cold email automation with unlimited sending accounts, automated warmup, automatic email account and domain setup, a unified inbox (Unibox), A/B testing, and API v2 with webhooks.
Sales automation and lead management suite; LinkedIn cites a lead database of 450M+ leads.

business_model_description.value: Free start ('Start For Free', no credit card required) with a separate pricing page; also runs partner, affiliate, referral, and solution-partner programs. Plan prices are not given on the page.
Flat-fee SaaS subscription; Growth plan at $37 per month (5K sends, unlimited accounts) and Hypergrowth plan at $97 per month; another source gives a $197 tier.

customer_description.value: Agencies, freelancers, founders, enterprises, and sales, marketing, and sales development teams; claims 50,000+ sales teams have switched; logos include HP, Sony, Stripe, Ramp, Revolut, and Linear.
Logos shown include HP, Sony, Twitter, Stripe, Lovable, Flexport, Ramp, Revolut, and Linear; claims '50,000+ sales teams' have switched.
Agencies, SDR teams, and founders, plus small sales teams doing their own outbound prospecting.

founded_year.value: 2021 (another source says it launched in January 2022)

headquarters.value: Sheridan, Wyoming (LinkedIn and several other sources)
